// PROBE: the where is unscoped and nothing groups, but a COMMENT mentions the
// compliant filter. A guard once passed on a mention inside a comment; this
// probe exists to prove this one does not.
export async function getHistory(db: any, userId: string) {
    // channel: 'in_app' — we should probably scope this like the bell does
    return db.notificationEvent.findMany({
        where: { userId },
        orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    })
}
